material.zh: 动物来源基底膜提取物

price.zh: 195.06 美元 / 瓶 · 美国目录

implication.en: An established workflow reference. Diligence should test whether a new material earns the cost of protocol revalidation, including lot consistency and model function.
implication.zh: 作为既有工作流的参照，新材料需要证明其改善足以抵偿重新验证流程的成本，尤其要看批次一致性和模型功能。

spec.en: G94-1 · 2.4 mL final gel · 400 Pa shear modulus · 0.4 mM RGD
spec.zh: G94-1 · 可配制 2.4 mL 凝胶 · 剪切模量 400 Pa · RGD 0.4 mM

material.zh: RGD 修饰葡聚糖 / MMP 可切割交联剂

price.zh: 293 欧元 / 套 · 厂商目录

implication.en: Defined mechanics and adhesion chemistry need matched biological validation. Price the finished working gel and recovery reagents, rather than the dry polymer alone.
implication.zh: 明确的力学和黏附参数仍需配套生物学验证；成本应按最终工作凝胶及回收试剂核算，不能只比干聚合物价格。

price.en: Regional quotation; no verified current price shown
price.zh: 按地区询价；未列入未核实的现价

implication.en: Assess the complete formulation needed by the target cell type. Additional adhesion components can change both the protocol and the cost per experiment.
implication.zh: 应比较目标细胞真正需要的完整配方；额外黏附组分会同时改变实验流程和单次实验成本。

spec.zh: AVP005-96 · 96 个 12 孔板规格 insert

price.zh: 76,400 日元 / 包 · 日本目录 · 未税

implication.en: A solid insert has no meaningful price per mL. Compare seeded area, usable wells, imaging access and cell recovery within the intended assay.
implication.zh: 固体 insert 不适合换算为每毫升价格；应按接种面积、有效孔数、成像条件和细胞回收流程比较。

spec.en: Gelatin methacryloyl · formulation and grade dependent
spec.zh: 甲基丙烯酰化明胶 · 需明确配方及等级

implication.en: Curing equipment, light exposure, initiator and formulation all enter the adoption cost. Research and manufacturing grades address different buying decisions.
implication.zh: 固化设备、光照、引发剂和配方都应计入采用成本；研究级与生产相关等级对应不同采购需求。

price.en: Regional quotation; no verified current price shown
price.zh: 按地区询价；未列入未核实的现价

implication.en: Assembly, seeding consistency and compatibility with the final readout belong in the comparison alongside the appeal of a peptide-defined matrix.
implication.zh: 除多肽组成这一特点外，还需比较成胶操作、接种一致性，以及与最终检测方法的兼容性。

price.en: No current continuity assumed: business closed in September 2025
price.zh: 不假设持续供货：该业务已于 2025 年 9 月关闭

implication.en: A 2026 update to the case: supplier continuity and requalification risk matter even when a material has attractive technical properties. This was not a finding available in March 2024.
implication.zh: 2026 年补充观察：即使材料性能有吸引力，也要考虑持续供货与重新验证供应商的风险。这并非 2024 年 3 月就能得出的判断。
